wikiclonecomment-attribution:
Attribution banner shown above every cloned article. Satisfies CC BY-SA by naming the source, crediting the authors and marking which part of the page is reused.

Parameters:
* $1 - link to the upstream article, label is the article title
* $2 - link to the upstream page history, label is {{msg-mw|wikiclonecomment-authors}}
* $3 - link to the exact upstream revision that was copied, label is the revision id
* $4 - link to the licence the upstream text is under, e.g. CC BY-SA 4.0
* $5 - name of the upstream site, e.g. Wikipedie
* $6 - date and time of the last successful sync
wikiclonecomment-authors: Link label inside {{msg-mw|wikiclonecomment-attribution}}. Points at the upstream page history, which is the accepted way of crediting every author of the reused text.
wikiclonecomment-comment-label: Heading of a commentary box, distinguishing this wiki's words from the copied article.
wikiclonecomment-comments-heading: Heading above commentary shown when the cloned article itself is not available yet.
wikiclonecomment-not-synced:
Shown when a page declares a clone but no copy has been downloaded yet. Parameters:
* $1 - the upstream article title
wikiclonecomment-source-conflict:
Shown when the shadow page holding the copy belongs to a different upstream wiki than the one this page asks for. Parameters:
* $1 - the upstream article title
* $2 - host the stored copy came from
* $3 - host this page asked for
wikiclonecomment-orphaned-intro:
Introduces comments whose anchor heading disappeared from the source article. Parameters:
* $1 - number of such comments
wikiclonecomment-orphaned-anchor:
Shown inside an orphaned comment box. Parameters:
* $1 - the anchor the comment was pinned to, underscores replaced by spaces
wikiclonecomment-error-no-target: Parser error: the clone directive was given no argument.
wikiclonecomment-error-no-sources: Parser error: $wgWikiCloneSources is empty, so nothing can be cloned.
wikiclonecomment-error-source-not-allowe:
Parser error: the requested host is not on the allow-list. Parameters:
* $1 - the rejected host
* $2 - comma-separated list of allowed hosts
wikiclonecomment-error-bad-url:
Parser error: the given URL contains no recognisable article title. Parameters:
* $1 - the URL as typed
wikiclonecomment-error-ambiguous-source: Parser error: a bare page title was used while several sources are configured and none is the default.
wikiclonecomment-error-duplicate: Parser error: more than one clone directive on a single page.
wikiclonecomment-error-encode: Error shown when the fetched article cannot be serialised to JSON for storage.
wikiclonecomment-error-foreign-content:
Save is refused because the page mixes free wikitext in with the clone directive. Also tells the author that pre-existing content is still in the page history and must be moved by hand. Parameters:
* $1 - a truncated excerpt of the offending text
